sg.title: Style guide
sg.intro: The design system of {{name}}'s website: colours, type, components, states and motion, with the owner's colours applied.
sg.leadSample: Lead text introduces a section in one or two calm sentences.
sg.bodySample: Body text is set at 16px with generous line height so menus, stories and directions stay easy to read on any phone.
sg.grid: 12 columns on tablets and desktops (4 on phones), at most 1240px wide, with 16–32px side margins.
sg.buttonStates: Hover lifts 2px, pressing settles it, keyboard focus shows a 3px outline, and disabled buttons are dimmed.
sg.motionRules: Content fades up 24px as it scrolls in, 60ms apart. Photos settle from 106% and zoom slightly on hover, and cards tilt toward the pointer on desktop.
sg.reduced: Reduce motion is on, so everything appears without animation.
